channel.title: Contributing to the Club :: FAU Cyber Security Club
channel.description: This is where learning turns into doing. Competing, writing writeups, helping newer members, building tools — this is where skills compound fast. You do not need to be an expert to contribute. You just need to show up and try. Ways to Contribute Compete Show up to competitions even if you do not know what you are doing. Watching how others solve problems is worth more than a week of tutorials.

item.title: Past Competitions
item.description: A record of competitions and events the club has participated in, along with the repos and write-ups from each one. These are worth browsing. Seeing how past members approached a challenge — what they built, how they structured it, what worked — is genuinely useful if you are gearing up for your own run.

item.title: Authoring
item.description: So You Want to Help Write the Wiki? This wiki is a community effort. Every page someone writes makes it more useful for the next person who joins.
